move: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method

provenance.why_not_zo: ZO does not model channels at all — it reads Burnice's Continuous Spray row as one instantaneous multiplier. There is no external golden number to cross-reference, so inventing one and calling it a ZO figure would be a fabricated citation of exactly the kind docs/DECISIONS.md records this repo shipping before (Nicole M1, Astra core, Lucy core). This fixture therefore pins RELATIONSHIPS that follow from the authored spec by arithmetic, not absolute damage read off a third party.
provenance.why_those_lengths: 2.0s is max_s and nominal_s (owner ruling D-CH4, 2026-08-19) — the hold the authored 543.80% multiplier is the total OF, so a full hold must reproduce it exactly. 1.0s is half of it, chosen because linearity in the hold length is the single property the whole whole_channel basis rests on: if a half hold is not half the spray, D-CH2's reading is wrong and every spray number in the game is wrong with it.
provenance.what_would_invalidate_this: A change to max_s/nominal_s (which rescales everything), to tick_s (which changes only the cadence and tick count, never the totals), or an owner ruling that revisits D-CH2's whole-duration reading.
